codecs.original_source: armbian/linux-rockchip rk-6.1-rkr5; original import did not record its commit
changes: Directly maintain the four imported codec source files.
Keep one ES7202 and two microphone channels for W132D.
Add the everest,es7202 binding and guard the optional I2C ID in OF probing.
W132D native HCI transport and Marlin3E-only Park policy quirk.
Firmware buffer ownership, DT device registration and rfkill fixes.
Management key storage and bounds checks.
Use compile-time firmware response buffer sizes instead of variable-length kernel stack arrays.
Integrate Linux 6.7 through 7.1 API adaptations; 6.19 changes already present behind version guards.
Omit unused embedded USB firmware and vendor utility programs.
Use the UWE5621DS source directory and board Kconfig option; preserve wire identifiers and module ABI.
uwe5621ds.hardware: UWE5621DS, as identified by the board maintainer
uwe5621ds.compatibility: Preserve verified module ABI and firmware paths: uwe5622_bsp_sdio, sprdwl_ng, sprdbt_tty. The maintained source directory and board option identify UWE5621DS.
